title: MIYCAN Project
summary: Improving maternal, infant, young child and adolescent health through nutrition, health education and preventive healthcare in underserved communities.

title: SOVCEST Project
summary: CHADI's flagship child protection and development programme supporting children with disabilities, orphans and vulnerable children through protection, counselling, education, skills acquisition and talent development.

title: HELP Food Distribution
summary: Delivering food and livelihood support to vulnerable families as part of CHADI's humanitarian response.

title: START Talent Development
summary: Supporting Talent Advancement in Rural Africa (START) - the talent development component of SOVCEST - through technology, leadership and entrepreneurship training for vulnerable children and youth.

title: Digital Skills for Youth
summary: Equipping young people with digital literacy, programming, graphic design and entrepreneurship skills.

title: Clean Water for Rural Communities
summary: Providing access to clean and safe drinking water through borehole construction and hygiene education (WASH).

title: Women Entrepreneurship Program
summary: Supporting women with vocational training, business mentorship and startup grants.

title: Green Africa Campaign
summary: Tree planting, environmental awareness and sustainable climate initiatives led by young people.

title: School Support Program
summary: Distribution of educational materials, scholarships and classroom renovations as part of SOVCEST's education support.

title: Maternal Health Outreach
summary: Improving maternal healthcare through free medical outreach and awareness campaigns.

title: Food Security Initiative
summary: Training farmers on climate-smart agriculture while providing improved seedlings and farming tools.

title: Community Health Volunteers
summary: Training volunteers to provide basic healthcare services and health education in rural communities.

title: CHOICES Project
summary: Creating Healthy Opportunities, Informed Choices and Empowered Students - drug abuse prevention, life skills and leadership development for students.

title: Youth Leadership and Civic Engagement Initiative
program: Youth Leadership and Civic Engagement Initiative
summary: Building a generation of ethical, confident and community-minded young leaders through mentorship, volunteerism and civic education.

title: CHADI Pad and Period Care Bank
program: CHADI Pad and Period Care Bank
summary: Ending period poverty and promoting menstrual dignity so girls can remain healthy, confident and in school.

title: Still Here
summary: Promoting mental wellbeing and improving the lives of children and young people affected by mental health challenges and sickle cell disease through awareness, prevention, advocacy, counselling and survivor support.
